test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

The rate of interest for the loan went __out all our calculations__.
solution:
The correct answer is 'beyond all our calculations'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We need to substitute 'out all our calculations.' with the most appropriate sentence from the given options.
 
• ** Beyond all our calculations is **an idiom that means outside the limits of something,not able to be done by someone or something.
 
 
• ***Example: **The influence of a mother in the lives of her children is** beyond calculation*****.**
 
 
 
• **​T**herefore, it is clear that the most appropriate option is **option 3.**

14
